item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins lawsuit stopping Trump administration from elimination of four vital federal agencies
item.description:
Publication Date: November 24, 2025

Court bars Trump Administration from dismantling federal agencies supporting libraries, museums, minority-owned businesses, workers, and services for the unhoused
